This document mentions `gpt-4o`, `claude-3-5-sonnet-latest` and
`gemini-2.0-flash` in prose. None of these should be reported as AI surface,
because documentation is not a dependency.

| Model | Provider | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| gpt-4o | OpenAI | general purpose |
| claude-3-5-sonnet-latest | Anthropic | strong at code |
